|lore=Bad-tempered '''smuggler'''. Makes a few credits more helping Jabba collect debts. Highly regarded for his uncanny anticipation in battle. Searching for Debnoli.
|anagram=[[Angel Eyes (The Good, the Bad and the Ugly)|Angel Eyes]] is Lee Van Cleef's mercenary, "the Bad", in the 1966 western.<ref name="wp-gbu">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Good,_the_Bad_and_the_Ugly The Good, the Bad and the Ugly], Wikipedia (Cast: "Clint Eastwood as 'Blondie' (the Man with No Name): The Good"; "Lee Van Cleef as 'Angel Eyes': The Bad"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027184439/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Good,_the_Bad_and_the_Ugly Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.</ref> ''Gela Yeens'' uses exactly the letters of Angel Eyes, and the fan list tags it BAD.<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians] at oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref>
|game_text=May deploy for free to your [Independent Starship] starship. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Power +2 when present with and opponent's smuggler. When targeted by a weapon, subtract one from each weapon destiny.
|joke=''Gela Yeens'' is an anagram of Angel Eyes, "the Bad" of ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'',<ref name="wp-gbu" /><ref name="geo" /> and the lore opens with "Bad-tempered". "Makes a few credits more" turns the title of ''For a Few Dollars More'' (1965), Sergio Leone's previous western, also with Lee Van Cleef, into credits.<ref name="wp-fafdm">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/For_a_Few_Dollars_More For a Few Dollars More], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015181342/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/For_a_Few_Dollars_More Internet Archive], 15 October 2026.</ref> "Searching for Debnoli" puts him on the trail of [[Debnoli]], the card that is Blondie. It is part of the running gag of the film's trio with Debnoli and [[Bron Burs]]. See [[Jokes#The Good, the Bad and the Ugly|Jokes]].
